name: Demo ICP: outbound-led B2B SaaS
summary: Series B to D B2B software companies with an outbound sales motion, selling to mid-market or enterprise buyers, headquartered in North America or Western Europe.

tests.label: Sells software to businesses (not consumers, not services)
Series B to D, or profitable with 80 to 600 employees
Has a sales team of at least 3 SDRs or AEs
Sells to mid-market or enterprise buyers (ACV above $15k)
HQ in US, Canada, UK or EU
Evidence of outbound (SDR job posts, sequencing tool, sales-led pricing)

disqualifiers: Regulated life sciences or clinical healthcare
rules: Every score must cite a specific fact from the source material.
If a test cannot be verified, mark it unknown and score it zero. Never invent evidence.
Any disqualifier present forces the score below the threshold regardless of other tests.
